assets.name: jump
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one isolated mobile game JUMP button sprite. A clearly pressable circular button, front view, centered on a square transparent canvas, occupying 90% of width. Cozy minimalist pastel clay game style. Warm ivory raised circular face with a substantial sage green rounded bevel/rim and darker green short lower edge, soft top-left light. On the face a bold dark teal UP ARROW with a small simple ivory cube rising beside it, embossed but very legible at 70 pixels. Strong button silhouette; not a loose floating icon. No text, no letters, no surrounding objects, no white canvas, no checkerboard baked into image. True transparent alpha background outside the button. Clean antialiased edge, subtle compact shadow, no glow.

assets.name: reset
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single RESTART LEVEL icon for cozy 3D mobile puzzle game. One bold clockwise circular arrow forming an almost closed ring, dark sage/teal green matte clay with subtle rounded bevel and soft top left light. Front view, clear recognizable reset/replay symbol legible at 35 pixels. Square canvas, centered icon occupying 85% of canvas. Transparent alpha background.
